text:
jen_design: Dropping a new take on the roles grid — compact columns, sticky header, and a persistent invite drawer on the right. Figma: https://figma.redwood/new-roles-drawer

sam_pd: Love the drawer idea. Main concern: invite drawer should show which role will be assigned before you type emails. Too many clicks today.

liam_fe: From a dev perspective we can surface a role pill at top of drawer. If long role names exist, truncate with ellipsis + title attribute. We'll lazy-render member list to keep perf decent.

keisha_a11y: Truncation's fine but title attributes aren't reliably announced by some screen readers. Add an offscreen full-name element for SRs or expose fullName via aria-label on the pill.

andre_security: Also need explicit language when a role inherits permissions from another role. Right now it's invisible. Suggest an info icon: "Inherited from <role> — includes X, Y".

jen_design: Good call. I'll include an inherit badge with microcopy. Small tooltip explaining inheritance model.

liam_fe: For the sticky header: beware virtualized rows — headers can detach from DOM positions. We'll implement CSS position: sticky on the container; virtual list must account for that.

tom_support: Can we add a quick-help link in the drawer for support agents to copy an invite link or prefill troubleshooting steps? Would speed up support flows.

sam_pd: Hmm maybe a small kebab in drawer header with "Copy invite link" and "Open support template". But restrict copy invite if SSO is required org-wide.

andre_security: Exactly. If SSO required, invite link should be disabled and show a tooltip: "SSO required — org owner can allow email invites via override." Must log override events in audit.

keisha_a11y: Focus behavior for opening the invite drawer should trap focus inside and return focus to the triggering control on close. Use aria-modal=true and ensure Escape closes it. Currently FocusTrap in our library does that but double-check tab order.

jen_design: I'll add a keyboard flow note in Figma: opener button -> drawer header close -> role select -> email input -> send.

liam_fe: Role select will be a combobox. We'll implement aria-activedescendant and listbox pattern. Large orgs will have 120 roles, so need typeahead.

keisha_a11y: For combobox, expose aria-controls/id relationships and listbox items should contain role description (visually hidden) so screen readers know what permissions the role gives briefly.

sam_pd: Copy tweaks: change "Make owner" action to "Transfer ownership" and add a tiny warning: "This will change billing and primary contact."

andre_security: Transfer needs an audit confirmation step that lists dependent services (billing, SSO configs). And require owners to confirm via typed org name for high-sensitivity orgs.

jen_design: Good — I'll mock a confirm dialog with typed org name option for orgs with >500 seats or with billing linked.

liam_fe: About the roles table columns: propose togglable columns (members, last active, created). Default hides last active for privacy. Can be persisted per user in localStorage.

tom_support: Support loves last active for troubleshooting. Could we enable a quick filter column only for support role accounts?

andre_security: Exposing last active has PII risk. If enabled, show relative time and obfuscate exact timestamps unless user has permission. Also put an audit event when someone toggles exposure.

keisha_a11y: Column reorder needs to be keyboard accessible (drag handles provide keyboard move up/down). ARIA live region should announce when column moved.

jen_design: I'll add drag affordances and a tiny help text "Press space then arrow keys to move column".

liam_fe: Visual-diff note: sticky header + drawer caused baseline shift in tests. I'll add an anchor element to keep layout stable.

ci-bot: visual-tests: 2 diffs detected — roles-header, invite-drawer.

jen_design: Thanks, Liam. One more: audit nav — proposal to add a tiny persistent "Audit" icon in org header (eye + clipboard). Clicking opens /orgs/:id/audit. Also breadcrumb inside settings.

andre_security: Persistent icon is helpful. Make it prominent and restrict to users with audit_read scope. Also show a small unread-events counter (capped at 99+).

sam_pd: UX nit: unread counter color must meet contrast; avoid red-only status for colorblind users — add text tooltip like "12 new audit events".

keisha_a11y: Make sure the counter is announced via aria-live polite and include sr-only text for the count. Tooltip accessible via keyboard (focus) too.

jen_design: I'll attach final screens and a copy variants doc. Can everyone check accessibility notes before EOD Friday?

liam_fe: Will review code implications Friday morning and post technical notes.

tom_support: I'll draft the support template for the drawer menu — will share in the thread.

andre_security: Security will review tooltip and audit flows. Expect comments Monday.

keisha_a11y: I'll schedule a quick axe run on Friday once mocks are updated.

jen_design: Great work. I'll push updated Figma and PR description with copy options. Ping here when done.
